records.text: Turning Point USA moved the Believers Summit after it could not move the free tickets.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Similarly, they had to move the Believers Summit, something that they advertised for last year. It was slated to take place back in October, but they could not move any free tickets.

verification.notes: Live searches found no reliable source confirming that the Believers Summit was moved because free tickets could not be distributed. No direct event record or organizer statement established the asserted reason.

records.text: Owens said the Believers Summit ended up being canceled.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yeah, the Believer Summit, that ended up being canceled, by the way. VIP lounge sponsorship, hyperlinked logo placements, text to attendees. They get a kiosk ad, a two-minute main stage video, an LED premium booth, and 10 minutes of main stage speaking.
